summaries.refunds: For a paid Trayage license, use the policy for your purchase route. The app’s refund page explains direct purchases and Apple-billed purchases.

summaries.refunds: StylePort is free, open source, and available directly and on the Mac App Store. Optional website contributions and Apple-billed tips do not unlock features. Use the payment provider on your receipt for payment or refund help.
summaries.privacy: Covers local styles and settings, Safari website access, direct updates, website analytics, and optional Apple/RevenueCat tips or Stripe contributions.
summaries.terms: StylePort is free and open source under GPL-3.0. Both the direct and Mac App Store editions include every feature. Optional tips and website contributions do not buy a license or unlock features.

summaries.refunds: Drift is free. Optional support links use the payment services identified on Drift’s website. For a support-payment question, use that service’s receipt and contact details.
summaries.privacy: Covers the Chrome extension’s local preferences, temporary drafts, Mastodon handoff, and the Drift website.
summaries.terms: Drift is free, open source, and MIT-licensed. Optional support payments do not unlock extension features.
